45:     "INSERT INTO tasks (title, status, created_at) VALUES (?, 'done', ?)"
46:   );

part.text:
Implemented Handlebars template engine and layout support for the SSG.

**What was added:**
- `src/templates.ts` — Handlebars engine (`Handlebars.create()` per site for isolation): loads page templates from `templates/*.hbs`, layouts from `templates/layouts/*.hbs`, registers partials from `templates/partials/*.hbs`.
- `src/ssg.ts:108` — `parseMarkdownFile` reads `template`/`layout` frontmatter (plus `data`); `build` uses templates when a template dir exists, otherwise falls back to the legacy renderers. `renderPage`/`renderIndex` refactored into `renderDocument`/`renderIndexBody` with byte-identical output.
- `src/cli.ts` — new `--templates <dir>` option (default `./templates`).
- `src/types.ts` — `Page` gains `template?`, `layout?`, `data?`; `BuildOptions` gains `templateDir?`.
- `templates/`, `templates/layouts/`, `templates/partials/` sample structure at repo root; `handlebars` added to dependencies.

**Behavior:**
- Page template chosen via frontmatter `template:` (default `default.hbs`); layouts wrap page content via `{{{body}}}` (default `layouts/default.hbs`, chosen via `layout:`); partials usable as `{{> header}}` etc.; missing explicit template/layout throws a clear error.

**Tests:** updated `tests/ssg.test.ts` (legacy build pinned to a nonexistent template dir, `parseArgs` expectations), added `tests/templates.test.ts` with fixtures (frontmatter parsing, engine loading, default/custom template & layout, partials, escaping, throw cases, index templating, full `build`).
